# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.11 · Mac 3.0.5

## Changed

- **First-run Today layout** now uses the owner's own arrangement (habits strip, photo + rhythm beside the day plan, month calendar, tools, wide photo wall). Your saved layout is not changed.
- **Timeline opens on Daily**, and days with only a mood are left out.

## Fixed

- **Monthly review** stays empty until you write one; old automatic drafts (facts and copied week reviews) are no longer shown. Nothing is deleted.
- **Photo library** shows photos from every month.
- **Dark mode**: timeline mood icons show their colours.
- **Mac**: traffic lights sit evenly inside the sidebar card.

## Added

- **Day photos**: paste with ⌘V, drag to choose the visible part, switch between fill and whole photo.

## Mac app

If you have 3.0.2 or newer, the app offers this update itself (**Update and Restart**).

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.10` stays available.
